mostWorthwhile.text: Drilling the band was most worthwhile: the clear core preserves the brown layer between paler ice, making the sample's context visible.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the core in the case was a predictable final step, and the goal completed without showing its return.

surprise.text: I was interested to see the brown band captured with pale ice above and below it, rather than as an isolated fragment.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary; drilling obtained the sample and the case kept it frozen.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to learn what examination of the band and the earlier specimens reveals.
